receiptRules.domain: Join DomainObservationReview.RequestId/Source to the actual returned DomainProposalReview and its ProposalId/Fingerprint, then to DomainProposalReceipt. Confirm the actual request/result association; do not correlate by display names or assume all prepared-domain IDs are equal.
receiptRules.workflow: Keep original WorkflowId/plan hash/StepId/RequestId plus ExpectedSource/ObservedSource, ApprovalFingerprint, ScopeFingerprint and the original receipt. Verification uses the existing JobId/CaptureId/task/receipt fingerprints.
receiptRules.noInventedRecords: Approval rejection or cancellation before original commit may produce no DomainProposalReceipt. Record the actual absence and unchanged state; never manufacture a successful receipt.
receiptRules.retention: DomainProposalReceipt is a bounded 64-entry queue, not a durable complete audit. Preserve necessary local acceptance evidence promptly without adding another product ledger.
receiptRules.privacy: Do not persist keys, local connection configuration, raw model responses or unauthorized observation bytes. Use identities, hashes and minimal result codes; hashes are evidence, not signatures or approval authority.
receiptRules.syntheticVsHuman: Injected deterministic transport can verify API contracts; it cannot sign off real model quality, user approval, target-machine performance or actual apphost startup.
